visual_action: Donald Trump, in a suit and red tie, walks into a large auditorium and waves to an enthusiastic crowd of supporters. The crowd, composed of many older adults, cheers loudly, raises their hands, and records him with their phones. Trump stands behind a metal barricade, smiling, waving, and pointing at individuals in the crowd.
